title: LASEMA rescues elderly woman trapped by flood in Ipaja
text_snippet: Following heavy rainfall, LASEMA responded to various distress calls, including a rescue operation for an elderly woman trapped in her home in the Ipaja area. Marina, Lekki, and Agege reported extensive property damage.

title: Torrential rain submerges Alimosho communities
text_snippet: LASEMA, alongside NEMA and the Lagos State Fire and Rescue Service, conducted rescue operations after torrential rain submerged communities in Alimosho, leading to the recovery of two corpses and the rescue of nine individuals.

title: LASEMA handles 119 incidents in July 2023, cites drainage blocks
text_snippet: LASEMA attended to 119 incidents in July 2023. Analysis showed 80% of flood disasters were man-made, primarily due to blockage of drainage channels, waterways, and limited capacity of existing drainage systems.

title: 10-hour downpour causes flooding across Lagos LGAs
text_snippet: Following a 10-hour downpour in July 2024, severe flooding affected areas like Lekki, Alimosho, Ikeja, Kosofe, and Lagos Island. LASEMA strategized on de-silting drainages and clearing canals to reduce damage.
